title: The underworld in the Kalmyk epic Jangar

tellings.quote: And in the Jungre epic, the underworld is described. How creatures live there, how they communicate, how they come to the surface.

plain: Jangar, the old epic poem of the Kalmyk people of Kalmykia, a republic in southern Russia, is said to describe an underworld: "How creatures live there, how they communicate, how they come to the surface." This is told by a former president of a Russian republic, who is not named in the episode, as an old local account of beings living below ground.
